risks.risk: Whether the machine actually stitches correctly (timing, feed, tension) even if the motor sounds/feels okay.
risks.proof: A short video of a full test: threading + bobbin winding + stitching a straight line on fabric, showing tension results.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully proven for working condition (worst case: needs service/adjustment).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, foot pedal, manual).
risks.proof: A clear photo spread laid out: every accessory item labeled, plus close-up of the power cord and foot pedal.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete accessories/manual (worst case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Unknown exact model/variant; parts availability and expected performance can vary.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the machine’s rating/model plate (usually underside/back) showing model/serial and 'Made in ...' text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at a generic Toyota table-top sewing machine level without model-specific value.

risks.risk: Electrical condition (power cord/foot pedal) and safety.
risks.proof: Video showing the machine powered on with the foot pedal controlling speed; close-up of cord/plug condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as electrical function not guaranteed (worst case: may require electrical repair).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating/model plate (underside/back) showing model/serial and country of manufacture.
Video of a complete stitching test: threading, bobbin, straight stitch on fabric, and a quick zigzag (if available).
Photos of all accessories laid out (bobbin(s), needles, presser feet, seam guide, power cord, foot pedal) and the manual cover/first page.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Toyota table-top sewing machine, but key value drivers (exact model, 'Made in Japan', accessories/manual completeness, and verified working performance) are not provable from the images alone. Without a stitching test and model plate, pricing would be guesswork.
